message.content: {"findings":[{"cwe":"CWE-22","class":"AbstractUnArchiver","method":"extractFile","explanation":"The containment check in extractFile is insufficient: it compares canonicalDestPath.startsWith(canonicalDirPath) without appending a path separator, so an archive entry name that resolves to a sibling directory such as ../dir2/file can pass the check while still escaping the destination directory, and the tainted path then reaches new FileOutputStream(f)."}]}
